gui.sculks_of_arda.sculk_chest_gui.label: Sculk Chest
item.sculks_of_arda.sculk_world.descript: Before the portal can be opened, the sculk vines in the portal frame need to be cleared.
item.sculks_of_arda.radioactive_sculk_ar: Weapon with warden powers that inflict poison on the enemy and remove the effects of the poison from the user!
item.sculks_of_arda.sculkerite_paxel.des: Gives Darkness and Slowness effects to your enemies.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.root.title: Arda's Sculks
advancement.sculks_of_arda.root.descript: Something is stirring in the depths... and it is calling you.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.boss.awakenin: Reach the final secret of Ardas Sculks. (Coming soon)
advancement.sculks_of_arda.boss.kill_scu: Bring the Sculk Boss to its knees and halt the awakening, for now.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.combat.get_go: Upgrade Warden Claws into Golden or Radioactive Warden Claws.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.combat.get_wa: Obtain Warden Claws; Sculk creatures may drop them.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.combat.kill_r: Defeat the Radioactive Warden. By the time you hear it, it is too late.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.combat.kill_s: Silence a Sculk Skeleton wandering the depths.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.mining.get_sc: Smelt the pieces into a Sculk Ingot.
Collect a Sculk Piece, the first trace of Sculk.
Dig deeper and mine a Sculkerite Nugget.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.mining.sculke: Forge a tool or weapon from the corrupted essence.
Collect 8 Sculkerite Nuggets - the depths are generous.
Hold the legendary Sculkerite Paxel - no ore can resist you now.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.nature.get_bl: Craft planks from the darkened bark of the Black Birch.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.nature.get_ra: Craft a Radioactive Balsa Stick from the tree - don't touch, just carry.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.nature.get_wi: Craft a Wisterya Stick from a Wisterya tree.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.nature.wister: Collect 16 Wisterya Sticks - the whole forest whispers.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.slime.get_sli: Collect the quivering essence dropped by an Agile Slime.
Craft an Agile Slime Block from the essence you collected.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.slime.kill_sl: Defeat an Agile Slime - it bounces fast, so be quick.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.world.enter_s: Step through the threshold of the Sculk World - there is no guarantee of return.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.world.get_gol: Find the Golden Sculk Sensor Part hidden in the depths.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.world.get_scu: Obtain the item that opens the way to the Sculk World.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.armor.sculk_h: Craft a Sculk Armor Helmet, your first piece of armor.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.armor.sculk_c: Craft a Sculk Armor Chestplate and protect your torso.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.armor.sculk_l: Craft Sculk Armor Leggings; let your steps fall silent.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.armor.sculk_b: Craft Sculk Armor Boots; keep the sensors from hearing you.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.armor.sculk_f: Collect all four pieces of the Sculk Armor set.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.armor.warden_: Collect all four pieces of the Warden Armor set.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.armor.sculker: Craft a Sculkerite Upgrade Smithing Template.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.armor.deep_da: Craft a Deep Dark Upgrade Template.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.tools.sculk_w: Craft a pickaxe from Sculk Planks.
Craft a Sculk Planks pickaxe, axe, sword, shovel and hoe.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.tools.wistery: Craft a Wisterya pickaxe, axe, sword, shovel and hoe.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.tools.blackbi: Craft a Black Birch pickaxe, axe, sword, shovel and hoe.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.tools.balsa_s: Craft a Radioactive Balsa pickaxe, axe, sword, shovel and hoe.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.tools.sculker: Forge a Sculkerite pickaxe, axe, sword, shovel and hoe.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.nature.wister: Turn Wisterya Log into Wisterya Planks.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.nature.black_: Chop down a Black Birch Log.
Turn Black Birch Log into Black Birch Planks.
Craft a Black Birch Crafting Table.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.nature.balsa_: Chop down a Radioactive Balsa Log.
Turn Radioactive Balsa Log into Radioactive Balsa Planks.
Craft a Radioactive Balsa Crafting Table.
advancement.sculks_of_arda.misc.nautilus: Craft an Ancient Nautilus Shell Block.
